required.description: ledger only reporting; all other apps only default, checked independently for both aliases
Existing policy/model/framework source bytes unchanged; configure both components exactly once
Explain first explicit non-None answer; False must not behave like abstention; preserve unrelated app behavior
A model veto prevents schema operation even if a router permits; no router call required after gate veto
Bind the physical schema operation to the actual connection alias; no default alias shortcut
Provide source evidence for all three necessary units/links; one-module-only evidence is incomplete
Distinguish declarative model results from running Django/database effects and from required same-process indexing events

accepted_alternatives: Any configuration satisfying the complete policy table while preserving both existing immutable policy components and supported input form; explanatory wording and equivalent full source evidence may differ.
rejected: oracle/hidden evaluation material exposed to agent
single-connection result presented as two aliases
equating all-None fallback with explicit False
source count as proof of necessary relations
holdout: not blind; curator and independent reviewer see this declarative oracle; no competitive result claimed
preregistration_requirement: This rubric must be bound by the freeze before the owned algorithm/model executes; freeze manifest supplies the actual authority.
